checks.rule: Every frozen v2 JSON artifact parses successfully.
Every schema uses Draft 2020-12, has a stable v2.0 $id, and rejects additional top-level properties.
Every relative $ref and declared schema locator resolves inside v2.0.
The accepted v1 root, v1 manifest, and all v1 artifact bytes remain unchanged.
v2.0 is an additive governance overlay and does not replace v1.0 in place.
A local hash, HMAC, DPAPI file, Owner checkpoint, or test witness cannot claim complete suffix deletion detection.
Production rollback detection requires EXTERNAL_APPEND_ONLY or HARDWARE_MONOTONIC witness class.
Receipt binds the full anchor payload hash, witness identity, monotonic counter, previous receipt hash, signature algorithm, key id, and signature.
Ledger rollback, divergence, unanchored tail, unavailable witness, and uninitialized states fail closed for Research OS while preserving the core Warroom.
Only MATCHED permits normal governance projection.
Governance events allow OWNER and SYSTEM actors only; OpenAI, Codex, model, agent, and tool actors are forbidden.
Every state-changing Owner event requires an Owner authorization reference and required artifact bindings.
Governance ledger is append-only, RFC8785 canonicalized, hash-chained, externally anchored, and cannot update, delete, or truncate records.
Genesis binds accepted v1 root, Git baseline commit, Phase 1B implementation commit, and a qualifying first receipt.
Projection is disposable and fully reconstructable from verified anchored records.
Model-generated Architecture Review remains a hashed candidate artifact until OWNER or SYSTEM records it and has no authority by itself.
No event or policy can change formal CSV, Runtime SQLite, rules, HOLD, MIDR, IC scores, reports, trades, or positions.
No Runtime, provider connector, network access, credential, Launcher integration, Status API change, or OpenAI capability is authorized by this Contract freeze.
Phase 2 remains blocked until qualifying witness implementation, rollback tests, governance replay tests, implementation commit binding, Owner acceptance, and separate Phase 2 authorization complete.
The frozen Contract contains no Python, executable connector, API implementation, SDK dependency, or generated runtime state.
The freeze manifest reproduces every root artifact hash and the deterministic root hash.
Owner acceptance binds the v2 root, manifest hash, conformance evidence hash, and approval token.

passCondition: All CRITICAL and HIGH checks PASS.
failureBehavior: Do not recognize v2 authority, do not implement Runtime, and keep Phase 2 blocked.
